# Quartus 25.1 Agilex 7 real-data fixture

This fixture is minimized from qclose collection `20260907-114824`, produced
from the project's completed Quartus Prime Pro 25.1 final fitted database.  It
is not synthetic data and does not contain the Quartus database itself.

`detailed_paths.jsonl` retains ten complete Timing Analyzer path objects.
`neighbor_paths.rpt` retains the corresponding ten main-path property tables,
without the large before/after neighbor appendices. `bottlenecks.rpt` is the
small original qclose report, and `structured_evidence.json` contains only
node-level report records relevant to those ten paths.
`normalization_samples.json` contains real replica names extracted from the
same build's register-spread report.

Regenerate the mechanical subset from an existing collection with:

```sh
python3 tests/extract_real_fixture.py \
  /path/to/logs/timing-analysis/<run> \
  tests/fixtures/quartus_25_1_agilex7_real
```

`expected.json` is reviewed ground truth and is intentionally not generated by
the extraction script.
